messages.subject: Ion image 1:1 export
parts:
Dear all,

I am looking for a way to export a single ion image
at 1:1 scale ( 1 pixel = 1 pixel of the MSI )
ideally as a raster object
( alternatively as matrix or tiff image )

My problem is that the image() function
will always have a margin with axes
and varying pixel resolultions

Thank you !

;-) Uli

messages.author: 6033d3c0e7d242fa
messages.subject: Re: Ion image 1:1 export
parts:
I would suggest using slice() to get a matrix/array of intensity values. You can coerce this to a raster object with as.raster(). You might consider looking into the EBImage package to find a way to export directly to TIFF or manipulate the image as a raster.

-Kylie
